text:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER DUTY — High error rate alert
pagerduty-bot: service=ingress-apac2c, symptom=5xx spike, error_rate=12% (5m), latency p95=1.8s, pager: @ri_oncall
ri_oncall: on it. joining. any customer-facing pages yet?
sam_neteng: seeing anomalous SYN+RST on NLB fronting apac2c, NLB metrics show connections queued -> resets up 3x baseline. ALB target healthy check failing intermittently.
lee_infra: confirmed upstream Envoy shows 502 due to connection_shutdown upstream. kube events show long pod time_waits on ingress-controller.
eng-sre_jordan: are there recent deploys to ingress in apac2c? deploy-bot: deploy 3897652000 by ci/cd: ingress-config:enable-new-filter applied ~18m ago in apac2c (status: succeeded).
ri_oncall: rollback candidate? can we revert ingress-config quick?
sam_neteng: before rollback, we should mitigate traffic so customers don't see 5xx. Suggest shift 60% of apac2c Route53 weight to apac1c. TTLs are 30s.
lee_infra: I'll prepare traffic-weight update. giving command now:
```
# route53 change to shift traffic weights
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z3EXAMPLE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood-inference.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"apac1c","Weight":60,"TTL":30,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"1.2.3.4"}]}}]}'
```
sam_neteng: also bump ALB target deregistration delay to 30s so in-flight connections have a chance. command: `aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:aws:tg/apac2c/abc --attributes Key=deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds,Value=30`
ri_oncall: performing traffic shift now. tagging with incident id INC-3897654321.
lee_infra: applying route53 change — done. monitoring DNS weight metrics.
customer_ops_olivia: customers EMR-42 and FIN-Enterprise reported errors in last 10m, both via support. status page still green but we'll update if impact widens.
product_emma: heads up — a couple of high-revenue tenants in apac2c. prioritize mitigation, please keep me posted.
eng-sre_jordan: I'm going to roll back the ingress-config filter in apac2c to test if that's the root cause. planning a canary rollback to 2 pods first.
ri_oncall: please coordinate with lee for config and with deploy-bot to do safe rollout.
deploy-bot: deploying rollback job 3897654300, target namespace ingress, strategy=canary, batch=2
sam_neteng: while rollback runs, flip NLB connection reuse off for apac2c targets (disable proxy protocol) to reduce half-open state.
lee_infra: noted. applying change to ingress-controller configmap: `keepalive_timeout: 15s`, `max_connections_per_worker: 1024`.
eng-sre_jordan: canary rollback succeeded on 2 pods, metrics improving on those pods (5xx -> 1.2%). proceeding full rollout.
ri_oncall: good. proceeding to full rollback. ETA ~6m.
customer_ops_olivia: sending short note to affected customers: "We're mitigating an ingress issue causing intermittent 5xx in APAC. We've shifted traffic and are rolling back a recent config; we expect reduced errors within minutes."
sam_neteng: Route53 weight shift visible, traffic to apac2c down ~58%. NLB queued connections dropping.
lee_infra: full rollback complete. ingress-controller pod restarts stabilizing. Envoy upstream 200s healthy.
ri_oncall: metrics check: error_rate now 0.9% (5m) and trending down. Latency p95 back to 220ms.
product_emma: great — please call it when fully mitigated. Need timeline for postmortem.
eng-sre_jordan: marking incident mitigated but still in monitoring. I'll own the postmortem. probable root cause: new envoy filter interacting poorly with ALB connection reuse, caused keepalive exhaustion and upstream connection shutdowns under burst.
sam_neteng: follow-ups: validate keepalive defaults, test filter interaction in staging with realistic connection churn.
lee_infra: infra actions: set default deregistration_delay=30s, reduce ingress keepalive to 15s in apac2c as temporary safety valve.
customer_ops_olivia: update: affected customers notified. support tickets triaged.
ri_oncall: handing off to eng-sre_jordan for post-incident write-up and timeline. I'm off-call in 10m; Jordan will coordinate timeline and RCA.
eng-sre_jordan: taking over. assigning postmortem: DOC-3897654321, timeline and mitigations due EOD.
deploy-bot: deploy 3897654300 rollback completed at 3897654380, all pods healthy.
ri_oncall: thank you team. leaving channel. :thumbsup:
eng-sre_jordan: final status: mitigated at 3897654385, monitoring to continue for 1h. will schedule follow-up with product and support for customer impact review.
product_emma: please include estimated downtime window and list of impacted accounts in the postmortem.
customer_ops_olivia: will provide list from support logs.
eng-sre_jordan: noted. postmortem owner: eng-sre_jordan. incident severity set to sev2.
ri_oncall: ack. closing live channel, will reopen if regression.
